memories.content: Mara made a ceramic cylinder in pottery class (2026-04-27) that didn't collapse, which her instructor Wen acknowledged with a nod.
Mara realized (2026-04-27) she hasn't done anything physical since running a half marathon about four years ago, and her body now feels tired in a way unlike running fatigue.

Mara befriended Priya, a nurse on her unit at the General who has worked there for years; assigned together this week, they clicked immediately and Mara considers her the first person at the hospital she'd call a friend.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: nurse on Mara's unit at the General

memories.content: Priya brought Mara homemade jollof rice (2026-04-27), and Mara has a cat named after jollof.
